title: Hormone Yoga in Coburg | Yoga Momente
description: Hormone yoga in Coburg after Dinah Rodrigues: for menopause, thyroid, cycle and vitality. Course or single class with Susanne Müller, on demand.

sections.title: Hormone Yoga
sections.lead: Vitality for women and men: bring body and hormonal system into balance.

sections.title: Hormone Yoga: what to expect.
paragraphs: Based on the proven practice of Dinah Rodrigues, dynamic body exercises are combined with special breathing techniques and visualizations that regulate the glandular system. Anti-stress and relaxation exercises harmonize body and mind. For balancing the hormonal system, for example menopause symptoms, thyroid or prostate problems, and for younger women from 35 with cycle disorders, PMS or an unfulfilled wish for a child.

items.title: As a single class
items.text: On demand within **Personal Yoga**: one-to-one with Susanne, on request in the studio in Coburg or at your home.

items.title: In group classes
items.text: Individual exercises can be included in the group classes, for example **Early Morning Yoga**. A separate course is possible if there is enough interest.

items.title: Who it is for
items.text: For women and men. Write to us and we will find out together whether and how Hormone Yoga suits you.

sections.title: Start with a trial class.
sections.text: One trial class of 60 minutes for €60. Write to us and we will arrange your appointment.
